title: Eid & Occasions
tagline: Ramadan, Eid, congratulations, condolences and the 'ne' past tense.
canDo: You can say the right thing at every occasion, happy or sad

grammar.title: The ne-construction
grammar.body: Past tense of transitive verbs (eat, drink, say, make, give, see): doer + ne, and the verb agrees with the object. maine khana khaya (khana m.), maine roti khayi (roti f.), Ammi ne biryani banayi. Pronouns merge: main + ne = maine, tum ne, aap ne, us ne. Verbs of motion (go, come) never take ne.

phrases.note: Roti is feminine, so the verb is khayi, whoever ate it.

phrases.roman: Eid mubarak, beta! Aao, gale milo
phrases.urdu: عید مبارک بیٹا! آؤ، گلے ملو
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Khair mubarak, Nani! Aap ko bhi Eid mubarak
phrases.urdu: خیر مبارک نانی! آپ کو بھی عید مبارک
phrases.en: Thank you, Nani! Eid mubarak to you too
Did you say your Eid prayers?
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Ji Nani, maine namaz parh li
phrases.urdu: جی نانی، میں نے نماز پڑھ لی
phrases.en: Yes Nani, I said my prayers
accept: ji nani maine namaz parh li

phrases.roman: Eid ke din bhi! Achha… phir bhi, yeh lo eidi
phrases.urdu: عید کے دن بھی! اچھا… پھر بھی، یہ لو عیدی
phrases.en: Even on Eid! Well… here's your Eidi anyway
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Shukriya, Nani! Allah aap ko lambi umar de
phrases.urdu: شکریہ نانی! اللہ آپ کو لمبی عمر دے
phrases.en: Thank you Nani! May God give you a long life
accept: allah aap ko lambi umar de

phrases.roman: Nahin, nahin, Nani! Main bara ho gaya hoon
phrases.urdu: نہیں، نہیں نانی! میں بڑا ہو گیا ہوں
phrases.en: No, no, Nani! I'm all grown up now

phrases.roman: Jeete raho! Ab sheer khurma khao. Main ne khud banaya
phrases.urdu: جیتے رہو! اب شیر خرمہ کھاؤ۔ میں نے خود بنایا
phrases.en: Bless you! Now eat the sheer khurma. I made it myself
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Bare ho gaye? Jab tak tumhari shaadi nahin hoti, tum bachche ho. Lo!
phrases.urdu: بڑے ہو گئے؟ جب تک تمہاری شادی نہیں ہوتی، تم بچے ہو۔ لو!
phrases.en: All grown up? Until you're married, you're a child. Take it!
phrases.speaker: nani

phrases.roman: Maine kha liya. Bohat mazedaar hai!
phrases.urdu: میں نے کھا لیا۔ بہت مزیدار ہے!
accept: maine kha liya bohat mazedaar hai

phrases.roman: Mashallah. Ab sab ko Eid mubarak bolo
phrases.urdu: ماشاء اللہ۔ اب سب کو عید مبارک بولو
phrases.en: Mashallah. Now go say Eid mubarak to everyone
phrases.speaker: nani

teach.title: Condolences
teach.info: When someone has lost a relative, keep it simple and quiet. Don't try to be clever: say 'Inna lillahi…' or 'Bohat afsos hua', and 'Allah sabr de'.

teach.title: The ne-construction
teach.info: In the past tense, verbs that act on something (eat, say, make, give) mark the DOER with 'ne', and the verb agrees with the THING, not the person. 'Maine roti khayi': roti is feminine, so khayi, even if a man ate it. Main + ne = maine.

exercises.explain: roti is feminine → khayi (the doer doesn't matter)
